comparison.objective: Candidate removes a connector terminal; record inserts a correctly oriented battery and screws on a flashlight cap.
comparison.physical_skill: Tab-targeted blade insertion and coordinated withdrawal versus close-clearance axial battery insertion followed by thread engagement and repeated cap regrasping/rotation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires one terminal out without housing, crimp, or neighbor damage; force/damage thresholds are missing. Record requires correct polarity, battery insertion, at least 300 degrees of threaded cap rotation, seating, stillness, and no drops or forced seating.
comparison.reason: Both involve constrained small-part manipulation, but threaded assembly and polarity control test different abilities from latch release.
